# Briefing Preferences

<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **Daily brief:** 07:30, weekdays. Order: (1) reliability/incidents overnight, (2) today's
  meetings with prep, (3) commitments due or overdue, (4) anything needing a decision today.
<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **Weekly preview:** Sunday 18:00 — the week ahead, top 3 priorities, and at-risk projects.
<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **Weekly retro:** Friday 16:00 — what shipped, what slipped, reliability numbers for the week.
<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **Always surface:** overdue commitments and any project whose status changed since last brief.
<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **Keep confidential:** refer to Falcon by code name in every brief.
